physics: Geant4_Modular (OpenTOPAS 4.3 / Geant4 11.4.2): g4em-standard_opt4, g4h-phy_QGSP_BIC_HP, g4ion-QMD, g4h-elastic_HP, g4stopping, g4decay
ion module name g4ion-QMD (G4IonQMDPhysics; OpenTOPAS 4.3 module lookup is case-insensitive)
source: 12C (BeamParticle GenericIon(6,12)), BeamEnergy 3480 MeV total kinetic energy (= 290 MeV/u x 12), monoenergetic, zero-size, zero-divergence pencil beam from z=-0.001 mm along +z at the face centre
geometry: G4_WATER box 120 x 120 x 300 mm, entrance face z=0; vacuum world 400x400x800 mm
scorers: Edep: EnergyDeposit, 1x1x300 bins (1 mm), Report Sum

C12Count: SurfaceTrackCount on Water/ZMinusSurface of each of 300 z bins, OnlyIncludeParticlesGoingIn, scalar filters i:OnlyIncludeParticlesOfAtomicNumber=6 and i:OnlyIncludeParticlesOfAtomicMass=12 (OpenTOPAS filter docs; surviving 12C incl. any secondary 12C)
PrimaryCount: SurfaceTrackCount, same surface, OnlyIncludeParticlesGoingIn, s:OnlyIncludeParticlesOfGeneration="Primary" and atomic number 6 (surviving primary carbon, any isotope)
units: TOPAS CSV headers: EnergyDeposit in MeV (run total over 200 histories); counts are track counts (dimensionless, run total; divide by histories for N/N0); 0-based bin indices, 1 mm z bins
rationale: independent Monte Carlo evidence for suite S-PHYS-PROTON-EM/-NUCLEAR/-LET (smoke: execution only)
